Sample.warning: The sample size was not reported in this section.

Country.evidence_source: However, the sample did include student deaths from a wide range of HEIs across the UK.

Population.evidence_source: Interviews with family and friends inevitably rely on their perceptions and reconstructions of the state of mind of the person who died. These reconstructions are then filtered through the researchers' perspectives and preoccupations (Denzin & Lincoln, 2003). However, this study used a range of informants to develop a complex multi-dimensional account of the events and circumstances surrounding student suicides.
